title: Naresh Chand v. State of U.P. and others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Prakash Krishna and Yogesh Chandra Gupta, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed on clause 6.5 alternative remedy; stay vacated.
headnote: On counsel stating that the petitioner would avail the alternative remedy under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the Allahabad High Court dismissed the writ and vacated the stay, without deciding the underlying electricity dispute.
facts: Naresh Chand filed Writ-C No. 40127 of 2009 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and others in an electricity supply dispute. On 6 August 2009 a Division Bench adjourned the matter so that counsel for the distribution licensee could take instructions, and it was listed again on 11 August 2009. When the petition was heard on 22 January 2010, counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner would pursue the alternative remedy under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: Where the consumer elects to pursue the alternative remedy under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the writ petition is dismissed on that ground and any interim stay is vacated.

not_decided.point: merits of the underlying electricity dispute
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the supply or billing complaint; disposal rested solely on the petitioner's election of clause 6.5.
